items.body_excerpt: The assist itself is a fairly simple handoff, but I love the Nets letting Day'Ron Sharpe facilitate the offense from up top like this. Sharpe keeps his dribble alive as Brooklyn runs a few different screen action, before flowing into the handoff to Michael Porter Jr. We're going to see this a lot.
